description: Finite-sample quantiles of the DF-GLS statistic (Elliott, Rothenberg and Stock 1996) under the unit-root null, as response surfaces in T (length of the series) and k (lagged differences). Decision D11 of the specification.
model: q_p(T, k) = intercept[p] + slopes[k][p][1] / T + slopes[k][p][2] / T^2 + slopes[k][p][3] / T^3

usage.p_value: F(stat) = pnorm of the linear interpolation of qnorm(probs) against the quantiles at the statistic (monotone, exact at the tabulated probabilities); p = F for this lower-tail test. Beyond the quantiles do not extrapolate: report the bound 0.001 (stat <= q[0.001]) or 0.999 (stat >= q[0.999])
usage.outside_design: use k = min(k, max(k)); use T = max(T, Tmin[k]) from design; never extrapolate; warn

statistic: t ratio of yd_{t-1} in the OLS regression of diff(yd)_t on yd_{t-1} and k lagged differences of yd, t = k+2..T, where yd is y GLS-detrended with cbar = -7 (c) or -13.5 (ct)

source.simulation: random walk, N(0,1) innovations; T = 20..1000, k = 0..21; 40 experiments x 10,000 replications per (T, trend); fit on T >= 25 by WLS with weights 1/se^2

reference_values.note: R unitroottools 0.1.1: critical values at 1/5/10% and p-value of `stat`; an implementation reading this file should reproduce them to 1e-12
